description: Move an application to a new status (e.g. SHORTLISTED, INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED, REJECTED). The candidate is told, exactly as when you change it in the workspace. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

notes.description: Private notes for your team (replaces the current notes). Never shown to the candidate.

status.description: The candidate is told about the change.

name: update_application_status
